one_liner: GitHub has a broad REST API (OpenAPI described, webhooks) with GitHub App, fine-grained PAT and OAuth authorization docs; no partnership is needed, but pages don't settle free access or MCP.
auth_notes: Docs navigation lists OAuth authorizations, fine-grained PATs, and GitHub App installation/user tokens. GitHub App JWT minting is from background knowledge; flow details are not on the fetched pages.
access_notes: Pages do not state pricing for API access. Developer Program membership is open to individual developers; Technology Partner program (5,000 users, 10 Enterprise customers) is optional and for enterprise co-marketing. Free access rests mainly on background knowledge.
blocker_notes: No blocker evident in the fetched pages. Partner programs are optional. Some endpoints may depend on plan of the underlying feature.
